takeaways: Unlike a reactive chatbot, an AI agent works proactively and autonomously, with its own identity and access to business systems.
Microsoft offers three build paths: Agent Builder for no-code, Copilot Studio for low-code business workflows and Azure AI Foundry for pro-code developer control.
Agent 365, Entra Agent ID, Purview, Conditional Access and Defender govern agents with the same rules that apply to human employees.
hook: Many people still think an AI agent is just a smarter chatbot, and that misunderstanding leads to poor decisions. This episode explains for business users, makers and IT admins what really makes an agent different. You will learn the three ways to build agents in the Microsoft ecosystem and how identity, governance and security keep them under control.
